seo.description: Curly top fade haircuts in Carlsbad, NM: natural curls on top, sides faded short to skin. For adults and kids. See the cut and book on Booksy.

photo_alt.cut-curly-top-skin-fade: Curly top fade on a young client, loose curls on top over a skin fade wrapping around the ear and the back

paragraphs: Curls on top, skin on the sides. A curly top fade lets your natural curl or wave do the work up top while everything below is faded short.
The photo shows it on a younger client: loose curls left with movement on top, and a skin fade that wraps around the ear and across the back. The bare sides make the texture above look even fuller.

blocks.heading: Made for texture.
paragraphs: This is a cut built around hair that already curls. The fade removes bulk from the sides, which is where curly hair tends to puff out, and leaves the top to show its natural pattern.
Straight hair but want more going on up top? The Perm on Booksy is built to add movement and texture to hair that lies flat.

blocks.heading: Pick the fade height.
paragraphs: A low fade keeps more hair on the sides and gives a rounder overall shape. Taking it higher, up to skin like the one pictured, puts the curls on a pedestal. A burst fade, curving behind the ear, saves weight for the back, which some people prefer as the curls grow.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: Curls shaped up top, sides faded, and the neckline finished with a straight razor. Kids can get this cut too.

items.title: Perm
items.body: For straight or flat hair that needs texture before a curly-top look can happen.

blocks.heading: Curls hide growth. Fades don't.
paragraphs: On top, a little growth just adds volume. The faded sides tell the real story, since that is where regrowth shows against the skin. Ask me what timing I'd suggest for the sides, and I'll give you my take for your hair.

items.q: What fade should I get if I have curly hair?
items.a: Any height works. Go low for a softer, rounder look, mid or high for more contrast, or a burst if you want to keep length at the back.

items.q: Curly top fade or burst fade: what's the difference?
items.a: The one pictured is a skin fade that wraps around the ear and across the back. A burst curves behind the ear and saves more length at the nape.

items.q: Can kids get a curly top fade?
items.a: Yes. Kids are welcome. Parents pick the haircut on Booksy that fits what their child wants, and the kids' haircuts page has more on booking.

items.q: What is a low curly top fade?
items.a: The same curly top with a fade that starts just above the ear, so more hair stays on the sides. It is a gentler version for school or work.
